history.summary: Brand-new (2025) integrated 1BR at Pasir Ris 8 for $1.0M / $1859 PSF — ~11% below the $2099 median — directly above CP1 Pasir Ris MRT and bus interchange with mall connectivity. Backed by an enormous 538-transaction series and a ~5.3%/yr resale-only rate, the integrated-transit-mall location plus CRL/DTL interchange upside make this a Buy despite a 1BR's narrower pool.
history.rating_rationale: Asking PSF $1859 is ~11% under the $2099 median on a very deep 538-txn dataset (high confidence), resale-only rate ~5.3%/yr is strong for OCR, and the unit sits 360m from Pasir Ris MRT inside an integrated mall/bus-interchange development — a structurally premium, highly liquid format. Cross Island Line interchange at Pasir Ris (~2030) is a concrete catalyst. has_new_launch_bias flags the headline rate, but resale-only is computed too and the value gap to median is real.
red_flags: has_new_launch_bias true on the blended rate (lean on resale-only ~5.3%)
